measured_before_touching.consequence: no declaration at all, so the browser asks the ORIGIN for /favicon.ico — and the origin is more30.com. The tab drew the portal's mark.

which_source_is_actually_served.trap: apps/23-haorech-torani/ is a static index.html titled 'העורך התורני — ארכיטקטורה ותוכנית בנייה', and its app.json says slug haorech-torani. It is NOT what /orech serves.
which_source_is_actually_served.how_resolved: production /orech returns a Next.js document (/orech/_next/static/...). The only next.config in the tree with basePath '/orech' is apps/18-torah-editor-mvp/next.config.js.
which_source_is_actually_served.note: the static file has a nav with an inline <svg> brand mark; copying THAT would have put another system's mark on this tab.

the_identity.graphic_mark: none — no <svg> anywhere in app/, no Header component, no nav
the_identity.so: the mark is the first letter of the wordmark the page actually draws — the same rule used for zchuyot
the_identity.pair_is_live_not_chosen: button.action is the accent token on background with the surface token on text; white-on-brown is a pair the page itself renders
the_identity.radius: 8px on a 37px button = 0.216, i.e. 10.4 in a 48 box (measured, not chosen)

the_font_was_measured_not_assumed.css_asks_for: 'Frank Ruhl Libre', 'David Libre', 'Noto Serif Hebrew', serif
the_font_was_measured_not_assumed.app_loads: none of them — no next/font, no @font-face ([...document.fonts] is empty in production), no font <link>
the_font_was_measured_not_assumed.document_fonts_check: returns true for all three — a known trap, it answers about fallback, not availability
the_font_was_measured_not_assumed.the_check_that_decides: measureText('העורך התורני') = 137.4297px, identical to 4 decimal places for all three names AND for generic serif
the_font_was_measured_not_assumed.conclusion: the h1 renders in the platform serif, so the letter was measured from what actually renders — unlike chizukim, where Frank Ruhl Libre was confirmed loaded and the letter came from it

how_the_path_was_made.method: rendered to canvas at 600px in the full computed font-family at weight 700, binarised at 128, marching squares for the contours, RDP simplification at 1.8px
how_the_path_was_made.what_the_two_contours_are: roof+right-leg as one body, left leg detached — the two strokes of ה. No holes, so fill-rule is irrelevant.
how_the_path_was_made.a_bug_found_and_fixed_in_the_tracer: RDP on a closed loop degenerates — first and last point coincide, so the baseline has zero length and every point measures 0 distance from it. The first run simplified 1304 points to 2. Fixed by splitting each loop at the point farthest from its start before simplifying.

deviations_declared_in_the_file: glyph height 32 of 48 (67%) — chosen, not measured, because there is no live tile to compare against (a heading on paper). It is the only unmeasured number in the file.
RDP tolerance 1.8px at 600 rounds the serif curves; that unit is 0.048px at 16px.

the_defect_this_round_nearly_shipped.what: the first version of favicon.svg served 200, at exactly the byte count on disk, with the correct image/svg+xml type — and painted nothing.
the_defect_this_round_nearly_shipped.cause: the Hebrew comment header documented the tokens as var(--accent) / var(--surface). Two consecutive hyphens are illegal inside an XML comment.
the_defect_this_round_nearly_shipped.parser_said: error on line 16 at column 61: Comment must not contain '--' (double-hyphen)
the_defect_this_round_nearly_shipped.caught_by: Image decode, not by status or byte count — which is exactly why update (24) put decode in this checklist as a separate assertion from status
the_defect_this_round_nearly_shipped.fix: the token names are written without their var() wrapper, and the file says why so it is not reintroduced

verified_on_a_real_render.how: next dev on port 4353, fetched through the basePath, then a real Chromium load of /orech
verified_on_a_real_render.not_grep: the assertions are the resolved href in the live DOM and the bytes the browser got back — not a string in a source file
verified_on_a_real_render.screenshot: sizes.png beside this file — 16/32/64/192 on a light tab strip, a dark tab strip, and both of orech's own paper tones

measured_on_the_16px_raster.why: at 16px ה can collapse into one blob, and the detached leg is what makes it that letter
measured_on_the_16px_raster.roof: rows 3-6, 8px wide (7 on the last row)
measured_on_the_16px_raster.gap: row 7 only — x6-x8 are clean rgb(122,92,46)
measured_on_the_16px_raster.peaks: all three regions reach exact 255,255,255 — 6.18:1 against the tile. chizukim's legs never reached full white; these do.
measured_on_the_16px_raster.tile_against_a_dark_tab_strip: 2.60:1 — the tile barely separates, but the letter is white and the letter is what is read
measured_on_the_16px_raster.tile_against_a_light_tab_strip: 5.55:1 — there the tile carries the identity

an_error_of_mine_worth_recording: three verification runs reported 'decode failed' and a 404 on the asset after the file was already correct. The asset was fine; the probe mapped the link elements to {rel, raw, resolved} and then read .href off the mapped object, so it fetched the string 'undefined'. The dev server log ('GET /undefined 404') is what settled it. Nothing was concluded about the file from those three runs.
